summary: The diff implements most of the required functionality: three-tab Admin Dashboard restructure (REQ-1), User Management tab with pending/all registrations and hidden Reject for admin's own row (REQ-2), Storage Management tab with editable quota inputs defaulting to 953.67 MB (REQ-3), and Recent Activity tab showing only login events (REQ-5). However, the backend login activity recording and admin-only query (REQ-4) cannot be fully confirmed from the truncated backend/main.mo diff, though frontend hooks like useGetLoginLogTable suggest backend support exists.

missing_requirements.requirement: Record a login activity entry in the ActivityLog each time a user successfully authenticates or is granted access, and expose an admin-only query to retrieve all login activity entries across all users (fields: user principal, timestamp, action type login). Non-admin callers must not access the full login activity list.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated and does not show the login activity recording logic, the ActivityLog population on authentication, or the admin-only guard for the login log query. While the frontend references useGetLoginLogTable, the backend implementation of recording logins and enforcing admin-only access cannot be verified from the truncated diff.
